skills.name: kindle
skills.description: Send a local ebook to Kindle with the zlib CLI, configure its SMTP delivery, or diagnose a failed send. Use the bundled zlib skill to search or download a book first.

skills.name: metadata
skills.description: Fix the metadata of a local e-book (EPUB, FB2, DOCX, MOBI, AZW3, PDF) with zlib - read what the file holds, look the book up in online catalogues, choose which fields to take, write them and rename the file. Use for a wrong or missing title, author, ISBN, series, publisher, date, language, cover or file name. Works through the zlib MCP tools or the zlib CLI.

skills.name: repo-readme
skills.description: Edit or review zlib's English and Chinese READMEs using patterns from popular TUI project READMEs, research new examples, and verify onboarding commands, TUI keys, and agent installation.

skills.name: security-scan
skills.description: Scan zlib for security problems before a release or after a dependency, network, credential, or file-handling change — govulncheck, secret scanning, GitHub alert review, and a credential-boundary code review — and handle a private vulnerability report through a GitHub security advisory.

skills.name: zlib
skills.description: Search and download Z-Library books, browse saved books and recommendations, inspect download history or account quota, and diagnose domain connectivity through the zlib CLI. For fixing local e-book metadata, use the bundled metadata skill; for sending a local file to Kindle, the bundled kindle skill.

skills.name: zlib-tui
skills.description: Change zlib's Bubble Tea terminal screens, book cards, list spacing, or shell navigation while preserving shared layout and selection behavior.
